name: Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory campus
notes: The point is the OpenStreetMap centroid of the laboratory property (bounding box about 0.8 km by 1.8 km). The Bevatron site is described by Berkeley Lab as the site of the Integrative Genomics Building (src:disc-lbl-elements-bevatron-40-years), but no coordinate for it was fetched.

summary.plain: The Berkeley Lab campus in the hills above Berkeley, California, where the Bevatron accelerator stood from 1954 to 1993.
summary.technical: Campus-level point for Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, Berkeley, California. The Bevatron building is not separately geolocated by any source consulted.
